deepseek-v4-pro.verdict: RELIABILITY FAILURE — mandatory non-disableable reasoning exhausts the fixed 4096-token output budget on all >=3-requirement jobs (11/30 jobs emit reasoning but no answer). Macro F1 on 44 reconciled requirements MUST NOT be ranked against 100-requirement full-coverage models. ELIMINATED from the shortlist regardless of the Sonnet comparable-control result. A bounded HTTP-client timeout+retry setting (ROUND1B_HTTP_TIMEOUT=90/ROUND1B_MAX_RETRIES=6) was used for DeepSeek only to let the run finish — HTTP-client operational setting, not a model-request change.

round1b_execution.prompt_bottleneck_status: HYPOTHESIS_STRENGTHENED (NOT proven). Cross-model error convergence — six records (4 providers + BOTH Sonnet output contracts) share a Partial-precision ceiling of 0.42-0.57 and the same over-prediction of Partial — PLUS the sensitivity of a fixed model to the output-contract shape (Sonnet 7-field -> 4-field shifted Macro F1 -0.016 and Strong->Partial 17 -> 23) strengthens the hypothesis that rubric / task communication is an important bottleneck. The causal share of errors attributable to prompt communication is NOT established and must be tested directly in the Prompt Ablation. No ~93% causal attribution is claimed. Next high-value experiment = Prompt / Rubric Communication Ablation on kimi-k3 + qwen3.8-max + the Sonnet control, then Dataset V2 held-out validation. No prompt change implemented. No production change.
